entries.title: Another computer can sign in to GitHub through its own GitHub CLI
entries.body: A computer that runs work for you can now use the GitHub sign-in that GitHub CLI already holds on it, as this computer can. In Settings → Projects, choose Sign in on that computer's GitHub row, then Use GitHub CLI under the code. Its row then says it signs in through GitHub CLI.

picture.alt: Settings, Projects, with a computer's GitHub sign-in code and, under it, a line offering Use GitHub CLI on that computer
